dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Max is at risk due to his behavioral concerns. In the prior home, Max has a reported history of three bite incidents. The most recent bite was to his owner's ankle while they were attempting to muzzle him for a walk, resulting in a deep puncture wound requiring medical attention. Previous incidents reportedly involved biting the owner's child while being petted and biting an individual in an elevator during petting. In care, Max has been easy to leash and handle. Medically, Max has Cataracts and Otitis Externa.

Max was brought to the care center following a bite incident in the home, after which the owner called the police to remove Max from the home. Max is noted ot have bitten the owner when they placed his muzzle on him for his walk, Max went after their ankle biting them and leaving a puncture. He is reported to have bitten 5+ which reported to have less severe nips. Max owners noted that he knowns sit, paw, come here and go home and he likes to get petting on the head. Max has not acclimated well to the kennel environment and has allowed only minimal handling since intake. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
